title: Four arrested in anti-illegal fuel operation in Batangas

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Four men were arrested for allegedly engaging in the unauthorized transfer and trading of petroleum products during an anti-illegal fuel operation in the Batangas town of Bauan on Tuesday (Oct. 27), police said. The operation stemmed from a tip received by the Batangas Police Provincial Office (BPPO) Intelligence Unit regarding the illicit operation in Barangay Sta. Maria. The Batangas police, personnel from the Batangas Maritime Police Station, and police from Bauan subsequently conducted an entrapment and buy-bust operation.
